units.source_text: 天色渐渐明亮，源氏公子送空蝉到纸隔扇边。

en.t: The sky gradually grew light, and Prince Genji escorted Utsusemi to the paper sliding screen.

units.source_text: 此时内外人声嘈杂，他告别了空蝉，拉上纸隔扇，回到室内的时候，

en.t: At that moment, voices were noisy both inside and outside; he said farewell to Utsusemi, pulled the paper screen shut, and as he returned indoors,

units.source_text: 心情异常寂寥，觉得这一层纸隔扇不啻蓬山万重啊！

en.t: his heart felt extraordinarily lonely, and he thought that this single paper screen was no less than countless layers of the distant Mount Penglai.
